title: ExchangeAccount (one connected venue account)
description: One connected venue CEX account. DISTINCT from a treasury Account and from a chain wallet: a CEX account is an IOU on a venue. INVARIANT (tested, quote from apps/api/internal/accounts/exchange/account.go): 'this record contains no secret material of any kind - json.Marshal of it can therefore never leak credentials. The vault link is CredentialID only.' The sealed material lives in executor.exchange_accounts (api_key_encrypted/api_secret_encrypted/passphrase_encrypted bytea + one 12-byte IV and 16-byte GCM tag per secret, concatenated in column order) and MUST NEVER appear in this object or in any response. Lifecycle is strictly ordered: pending -> active -> disabled -> revoked, enforced by TransitionTo.

user_id.description: Ownership scope; every lookup binds it (PRD 108). A Discord snowflake (numeric string), never parsed as a number.

credential_id.description: Opaque handle to the vault row. Contract-visible as a handle only - it is never a key, never a secret.

exchange.description: Lowercase venue name; the supported set is the venue allowlist (markets/venue.json).

status.description: Mirrors Status in account.go. NOTE: a DIFFERENT type with the same name exists in apps/api/internal/access/credentials/credential.go (active/revoked/unknown) - see canonical-model.md D-US2.

permissions.description: Venue-reported key restrictions. Every venue-reported flag is nullable ON PURPOSE: null means the venue is silent and is NEVER inferred as false (house rule: honest absence over fabricated zero). `read` is the only verified-by-probe flag. `withdraw` MUST be false or null in effect - the platform never requests withdrawal capability, and a true from the user's own key must be surfaced as a warning, never silently trusted.

last_sync_at.description: Null until the first successful venue sync - a missing sync is reported as missing, never as a zero timestamp. Monotonic: a retried/out-of-order sync must not rewind it (account.go TouchSync).
